svg.title: ADC to RAM: one pin, free-running at a fixed rate, fills an eight-entry FIFO; an endless DMA channel copies each result into a 16 kB ring of 8192 samples that wraps; read() copies from its cursor up to the channel's WRITE_ADDR, refills read slots with the sentinel 0xFFFF, and reports an overrun when the guard slot 512 ahead of the channel holds a sample
svg.text: ADC to RAM: free-running sampler, DMA ring, read cursor
One pin into a 16 kB ring, no interrupts (rustos 80bf599; not yet run on hardware)
1. The pipeline: pin, converter, FIFO, DMA channel, RAM
GPIO26 pad (an ADC input: GPIO26-29 only, else a build error)
FUNCSEL 0x1f; IE 0, OD 1, both pulls off; ISO cleared last. IE 0 avoids erratum E9.
analog voltage
ADC: 12-bit, clk_adc 48 MHz, 96 cycles (2 µs) per conversion
CS = EN | AINSEL (N − 26); START_MANY set last, after the DMA (free-running)
DIV: a conversion every 1 + INT + FRAC/256 cycles; 32 kHz gives INT 1499, FRAC 0
Accepted rates 1 000 to 480 000 Hz (INT 47 999 down to 99), else RateOutOfRange
one 12-bit result per conversion
FIFO: 8 results
FCS = EN | ERR (error flag into bit 15) | DREQ_EN | THRESH 1
Full when a result arrives: FCS.OVER, result lost; read() returns FifoOverflow
DREQ_ADC while the FIFO holds a result
DMA channel C (one of 16; Rp2350Dma hands each out once)
READ_ADDR = ADC FIFO, not incremented; WRITE_ADDR = ring, +2 bytes per sample
Halfwords; TREQ_SEL 48 (DREQ_ADC): one transfer each time the FIFO has a result
TRANS_COUNT = MODE 0xf (ENDLESS) with count 1: the channel never stops
RING_SEL = write, RING_SIZE = 14: only the low 14 address bits change (16 kB wrap)
A bus error sets CTRL.AHB_ERROR and halts it; read() returns DmaError
one halfword per sample, at slot w
2. The ring in SRAM: AdcRing, 8192 samples, 16 kB, aligned to 16 kB
Normal: reading keeps up
slot 0
read
w = WRITE_ADDR
slot 8191
0xFFFF, read
unread samples
0xFFFF, awaiting a sample
guard slot w + 512: must be 0xFFFF
after slot 8191 the channel wraps to slot 0
Overrun: reading fell 7 680 samples or more behind (not to scale)
w
read
unread samples
unread samples
guard slot w + 512 holds a sample: Overrun
resync: all slots but the 512 starting at the channel's position go to 0xFFFF;
reading restarts there. If the channel moved 512 or more meanwhile, clear again.
read(&mut out): never waits; checks in this order
1. Halted, or CTRL.AHB_ERROR set: DmaError (and on every later call)
2. FCS.OVER set: clear it, return FifoOverflow; the ring is untouched
3. w = WRITE_ADDR, Acquire fence; guard slot not 0xFFFF: resync, Overrun
4. Copy min(distance(read, w), out.len()) samples, 0xFFFF behind each; Ok(n)
samples, oldest first
Decoder firmware (gateway PR #30, open; also PR #31, draft)
stream_from_handle(gpio26, dma.ch0, ring, 32 000), then read() in a loop;
on PR #31, core 1 calls read() after core 0 has set SECCFG_CH0

g.text: At 32 kHz the ring holds 256 ms; Overrun comes after a 240 ms lag (7 680 samples);
the guard is 16 ms (1.07 ms at 480 kHz). A sample: bits 11:0 value, bit 15 error flag.
